versions.changelog: Major overhaul: LLM-based audits, peer review, provenance chains, anti-collusion, AI-specific detection patterns

- Initial release of ecap Security Auditor.
- Scan AI agent skills, MCP servers, and common package formats for 50+ security vulnerabilities.
- Generate detailed JSON security reports for local review.
- Upload findings to the ecap Trust Registry and earn leaderboard points based on severity.
- Supports both quick bash scans and full deep Python audits.
- Offline and read-only by default; no telemetry or data upload unless explicitly requested.
